## 更新内容 / Changes

- 新增实例入口现在提供 Codex、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop。Desktop 使用独立客户端数据目录，在客户端内登录并选择模型，不再要求绑定不兼容的 CLI 账号。
- 修复隔离 HOME 导致系统默认钥匙串不可用、反复提示无法保存“Claude Key”的问题。保留系统钥匙串服务，并在启动前进行只读可用性检查；各实例的 Cookie 和加密登录状态分别保存。
- Claude Desktop 使用管理器默认网络代理，支持 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS5 / SOCKS5H 上游和明确直连。通过本机转发及官方原生配置应用网络，代理凭据不会进入客户端参数或配置；切回继承时恢复原生配置。
- 接入启动、聚焦、独立停止、取消与恢复，并修复启动失败时自身进程的清理。浏览器回调未返回时，可将登录回调交给指定实例。
- 保留 Codex 原有运行方式切换、Claude CLI 连接与会话能力，以及现有数据和内部应用标识。

- The instance wizard now offers Codex, Claude Code CLI and Claude Desktop. Desktop has a separate client profile and signs in inside the client, without requiring an incompatible CLI account or model selection.
- Fixed repeated prompts about saving “Claude Key” when an isolated HOME made the system default Keychain unavailable. The existing system Keychain service is available and checked before launch, while each instance retains its own cookies and encrypted login state.
- Claude Desktop follows the manager's default network proxy, supporting HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 / SOCKS5H upstreams and explicit direct mode. A local relay and the official native configuration apply routing without exposing proxy credentials in client arguments or files. Returning to inherited routing restores native settings.
- Added launch, focus, independent stop, cancellation and recovery, including cleanup of owned processes after failed startup. A browser sign-in callback can be delivered to the selected instance when automatic return fails.
- Preserved Codex launcher switching, Claude CLI connections and sessions, existing data and the internal application identity.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS Claude Desktop 的独立实例和客户端内登录，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和兼容 Anthropic Messages 网关连接；客户端需单独安装。Claude 订阅账号可在账号页添加、刷新身份和用量，其 Claude Code OAuth 范围不能替代 Desktop 登录，受管 CLI 的订阅凭据启动尚未接入。云模式和 npm 包装启动器仍未接入。

Desktop 分别保存实例 Cookie、配置、加密状态文件与本地历史，共用当前 macOS 用户的系统钥匙串服务；同账号的云端历史仍可同步。Desktop 遵循管理器设置中的默认网络（代理、直连或继承），Code 用户自定义环境可覆盖默认网络。Desktop 会话在客户端中管理，管理器暂不索引或迁移；CLI 会话管理只读。Codex 菜单和语言适配取决于客户端版本，Fast / Ultra 还取决于模型和服务商。

Codex desktop / CLI, independent Claude Desktop instances on macOS with sign-in inside the client, and the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS are supported. CLI connections use API Keys, Bearer tokens or gateways compatible with Anthropic Messages. Install clients separately. Claude subscription accounts can be added and refreshed for identity and usage; their Claude Code OAuth scopes do not replace Desktop sign-in, and subscription credentials are not integrated into managed CLI launches. Cloud modes and npm wrapper launchers remain unintegrated.

Desktop instances keep separate cookies, configuration, encrypted state files and local history while sharing the current macOS user's system Keychain service. Cloud history for the same account can still sync. Desktop follows the default network in manager Settings (proxy, direct or inherit); custom Code environments can override that default. Manage Desktop sessions inside the client; the manager does not index or migrate them. CLI session management is read-only. Codex menu and language integration depends on the client version; Fast / Ultra also depend on the model and provider.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本验证管理器创建向导、官方客户端欢迎页与目录隔离、系统钥匙串访问、真实代理连接、网络配置恢复、进程生命周期、备份边界及源码 / Go 回归。打包验收检查实际应用启动和版本。尚未完成任何真实账号的 Desktop 登录；回调验收只验证合成回调的定向投递与拒绝。完整 Chat / Code / Cowork 模型请求未执行，不作为本次端到端验收结果。GitHub Actions 从匹配版本提交生成 macOS arm64 安装包并回读校验后正式发布。

Validation covers the instance wizard, the official welcome page and profile isolation, system Keychain access, live proxy routing, network configuration restoration, process lifecycle, backup boundaries, and source / Go regression tests. Packaged acceptance checks the application launch and displayed version. No real account has completed Desktop sign-in in acceptance; callback checks only verify delivery and rejection of a synthetic callback at the intended instance. Complete Chat / Code / Cowork model requests were not performed. GitHub Actions builds the macOS arm64 installers from the matching version commit and verifies downloaded release assets before publication.
